summary: She can open up to six pages in one turn instead of two, and the turn's token ceiling doubles again to make room for them.
details: The web_fetch budget was 2, argued as 'there is rarely a reason to open more than one or two links in a turn'. Measured false on the research shape: a live Discord turn spent four searches and two fetches and was then refused at the third fetch, mid-chain, on a question that needed the pages.
web_fetch is now 6, set as a per-deployment budget override rather than a code change, so the shipped default is unchanged for a fresh install.

The loop's cumulative token ceiling doubles 512,000 to 1,024,000 in the same change — six fetches cost more context, not less, so the two numbers move together or the fetch budget merely relocates where the turn runs out.
limitations: More fetching per turn also means slower turns; the 120s heartbeat wall-clock for unprompted turns is unchanged.
